characters.name: Mira Coil
characters.summary: Balanced storm-runner tuned for clean reads and steady pressure.
characters.onboarding_tip: Mira is the clean onboarding pick: dodge through the first telegraph, then use light-light-heavy to stabilize space.

characters.name: Zeph Rush
characters.summary: High-speed disruptor with faster movement, lighter armor, and tighter cooldowns.
characters.onboarding_tip: Zeph trades survivability for tempo, so weave short strings and dodge early instead of holding ground.

stages.name: Relay Clearing
stages.summary: Stabilize the relay heart before the storm warden buries the clearing.
stages.briefing: Open with patient footwork, let the first telegraph show itself, and treat this route as the clean read-and-react onboarding lane.

stages.name: Coil Depths
stages.summary: Descend through the vent conduits and stabilize the depth core before the overload collapses the shaft.
stages.briefing: Watch the vent telegraphs before you commit, then use the launcher or special to keep the conduit pack from surrounding you.
stages.mid_objective: Read the surge vents and push for the depth core
stages.boss_intro_objective: Brace for the colossus in the depth core

stages.name: Storm Crown
stages.summary: Climb into the storm crown, break the engine at its heart, and finally quiet the route.
stages.briefing: The finale asks for discipline: push until the wardens commit, dodge through the first hit, and only overextend once the rails are readable.
stages.mid_objective: Read the storm rails and push for the crown engine
stages.ending_summary: The crown engine falls silent, the route steadies, and Wildcoil finally gets to stand down from the storm line.

stages.name: Road Relic Run
stages.summary: Race through a fossil highway where rusted luxury roadsters, tar pits, and territorial thunder-lizards collide.
stages.briefing: This branch stage leans into road-brawler spectacle: clear the raptor pack, let the roadster charge open the lane, then break the tyrant guarding the wreck line.
stages.mid_objective: Follow the roadster wake to the wreck line
stages.spectacle_objective: Roadster charge breaks the fossil blockade. Push through.
